title: Early language services for children who are deaf, hard of hearing, or deaf-blind.
bodyText: Early intervention services for infants and toddlers may include, but not be limited to, service providers and mentors of the deaf, hard of hearing, or deaf-blind who use American Sign Language; service providers and mentors of the deaf who use oral language; American Sign Language teachers for families of young children; family-to-family support; and training of early intervention providers.
bodyHtml: [§321-352.2]  Early language services for children who are deaf, hard of hearing, or deaf-blind.  Early intervention services for infants and toddlers may include, but not be limited to, service providers and mentors of the deaf, hard of hearing, or deaf-blind who use American Sign Language; service providers and mentors of the deaf who use oral language; American Sign Language teachers for families of young children; family-to-family support; and training of early intervention providers. [L 2016, c 177, §2]
